agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 annual report and ratified the financial statements audited by KAP Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan, granting a full discharge of responsibilities to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved a cash dividend of Rp111 per share, totaling Rp3,579,840,016,227, and allocated the remaining Rp1,929,863,318,889 to retained earnings.
Agenda #3: Shareholders approved a total 2026 remuneration of Rp63,477,342,720 for the Board of Commissioners and delegated the authority to set the Board of Directors' remuneration to the Commissioners.
Agenda #4: Lok Budianto and KAP Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan (PwC network) were appointed to audit the company's financial statements for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026.
Agenda #5: The meeting updated the Board compositions, confirming Vikram Sinha as President Director and Nezar Patria as President Commissioner, while appointing new members and dismissing Ahmad Zulfikar. The 9-member Board of Directors and 15-member Board of Commissioners have terms ending in 2027 and 2030 respectively.
Agenda #6: The Board of Directors and Corporate Secretary were authorized to notarize meeting resolutions and notify the Ministry of Law and Human Rights regarding management changes.
Agenda #7: The meeting was held on May 5, 2026, and achieved a quorum with 94.2228% of valid shares, representing 30,387,599,006 shares, in attendance.
